# TANVO

> Digital strategy, design and development studio based in Hubli–Dharwad,
> Karnataka, India. We build websites, headless e-commerce storefronts,
> product interfaces, brand systems and custom web applications for
> regional and global clients.

## What we do

- [Web Design & Development](https://www.tanvo.in/services/web-design-development): Fast, responsive and scalable websites built on Next.js and React with headless CMS integration.
- [E-Commerce Flagships](https://www.tanvo.in/services/ecommerce-development): Custom headless Shopify Plus storefronts with sub-second product filtering, custom checkout, ERP and inventory sync, and multi-currency support.
- [UI/UX Design & Prototyping](https://www.tanvo.in/services/ui-ux-design): Product architecture, customer journey mapping, Figma design systems, interactive prototypes and WCAG 2.1 accessible interfaces.
- [Brand Identity & Systems](https://www.tanvo.in/services/brand-identity): Vector logo construction, editorial typography hierarchies, design token systems and brand guidelines.
- [Custom Web Apps & SaaS](https://www.tanvo.in/services/custom-web-apps): Bespoke web applications, internal operational dashboards and customer portals.

## Selected work

- Buy N Build — architectural platform with interactive 3D spatial configurators and an automated lead pipeline.
- The Slow House — headless Shopify storefront with editorial design and fluid catalogue filtering.
- Shivakrupa — heritage jewellery brand with a digital craftsmanship archive and private consultation booking.

## How we work

A four-stage framework: Discover & Immerse, Define & Strategize,
Design & Prototype, Deliver & Scale.
